text: I find myself surrounded by the trappings of inquiry and progress—glass-walled rooms, digital screens blinking with data, and walls emblazoned with words like 'R+D.' There is an underlying hum of innovation and curiosity. My mind is alert, yet anchored in the quiet awe of discovery. I feel inspired by the intersection of creativity and knowledge, as if standing on the threshold of new ideas, eager to explore what lies just beyond the glass.
